extracted.name: Mint sauce
extracted.description: Make a homemade mint sauce using finely chopped fresh mint, red wine vinegar and a little sugar – it's a classic sauce to serve with roast lamb
instruction_lines: Combine the mint, sugar and vinegar in a heatproof bowl.
Season with salt and pepper, pour in 4-5 tbsp boiling water and mix to combine.
